title: About 50-year-old 'pawikan' rescued in Albay

blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — Residents rescued a green sea turtle (pawikan) believed to be about 50 years old after finding it stranded along the shoreline of Sitio Banago, Barangay Alimsog in Santo Domingo, Albay on Friday, Sept. 25. The male sea turtle, measuring about 28 inches wide and 39 inches long, was weak and had a dry carapace (hard outer shell) when found, apparently stranded during low tide. The information comes from Dimple Catangay, municipal environment and natural resources officer. Residents covered the turtle with wet towels to keep its body moist while waiting for assistance.
